Accept the GenWiki Tabelle 2 non-underscore vendor tags (USM6, Mac
Family Tree 7/8, the RootsMagic FSFTID spelling) and type the twins of
the documented underscore tags: _FID, _AHNNR, _HEIRATNAME, _CALL,
_FRKA, _HNM, _INDG, _LNCH, _MARI, _PRI, _EVN, _CTYP, _WT_USER and
_CREAT. Keep vendor place cards as _LOC extension records on 7.0
export instead of flattening them away.

Run the official FamilySearch 7.0 test files as a regression suite and
fix what they exposed: SCHMA-documented tags with g7: structure-type
URIs now resolve to their standard structures, extension epochs no
longer serialize as BCE, extension-defined substructures and nested
standard tags survive instead of being rejected or dropped, and the
model gains the 7.0 FAMC/FAMS PHRASE slots. Extension emission gaps
under events, attributes, links and names are
